title: Scientology's claim to sovereign status and its Fair Game program
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Scientology's claim to sovereign status and its Fair Game program, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And what it is is that they they considered themselves entitled to being considered a sovereign entity because the Catholic Church was.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer who says he dealt with the Church of Scientology, says the church believed it deserved to be treated as a sovereign entity, like its own country, because the Catholic Church was. He also speaks of a church programme called Fair Game. He tells it to explain how the organisation saw itself and how it operated.
